CA.rationale: No attention/allocation condition explicitly linked to content organization; A absent

COD.rationale: Content identified (coordinate set), its presentation/organization shown (coordinate listing), and a separate origin/status entry provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented contents and attributes (colour) as coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields (e.g. completed_record/inherited_current/executed_branch_claim) distinguish content identity from its status/source.

O.rationale: Entries explicitly state how content is organized/presented (coordinate membership lists), a spatial/constituent organization.
